title: Sand Mining Now Outpaces What Rivers Can Replace
hook: Sand is vanishing five times faster than in 1970, and you're standing on it.
closing: Somehow, the beach is the crisis.
question: Could sand really run out? Comment below.

segments.say: We now mine 50 billion tonnes of sand and gravel a year, five times 1970's pace.
Rivers replace just 13 billion tonnes a year, so we take sand four times faster.
China pours about 51 percent of the world's cement, mostly sand and gravel.
